As we look ahead to the week, models suggest that a low-pressure system will start to develop over the region, leading to an increase in precipitation chances. My best guess is that this system will bring a significant amount of rainfall to the city, particularly during the afternoon and evening hours.

As the day progresses, the clouds will gather, and the chance of precipitation will increase, making it essential to carry an umbrella when venturing outdoors. However, as the day wears on, the heat will become more pronounced, and it will feel like the mid-30s in these areas.
